Prioritize CCA components by cross-loading stability

Source: R/prioritize_cca_components.r
prioritize_cca_components.Rd

Identifies the most stable features on each canonical component via repeated subsampling. On each replicate, run_cca is run on a random fraction of cells and features are ranked by their absolute cross-loading magnitude. Features that consistently appear among the top ranks across replicates are retained.

prioritize_cca_components(
  shape_mat,
  expr_mat,
  ccs_to_consider,
  shape_side_rank = 5,
  factor_side_rank = 5,
  num_replicates = 100,
  subsample_frac = 0.9,
  cell_subsample = NULL,
  num_times_among_top_ranks = 75
)

Arguments

shape_mat

Numeric matrix, cells x shape features, rownames = cell names. Should be the same (optionally scaled) matrix passed to link_shape_and_factors.

expr_mat

Numeric matrix, cells x NMF factors, rownames = cell names.

ccs_to_consider

Integer vector of component indices to evaluate (e.g. 1:3).

shape_side_rank

Integer. A shape feature must rank within the top shape_side_rank positions to count toward its tally. Default 5.

factor_side_rank

Integer. Same threshold for NMF factors. Default 5.

num_replicates

Integer. Number of subsampling replicates. Default 100.

subsample_frac

Numeric in (0, 1]. Fraction of cells to use per replicate. Default 0.9.

cell_subsample

Optional character vector of cell names to restrict the pool before subsampling (e.g. already-intersected cells for a group). Distinct from group.by filtering — this is purely for replicate subsampling.

num_times_among_top_ranks

Integer. Minimum number of replicates in which a feature must appear within the top-rank threshold to be retained. Default 75.

Value

A list with two data frames:

Shape

Shape features passing the stability filter, with columns feature_name, CC, cross_loading_mag, n.

Factor

NMF factors passing the stability filter, same columns.

See also

link_shape_and_factors, run_cca
